source: Official Cambridge IGCSE multiple-choice specimen papers and their published mark schemes, converted end-to-end with scripts/cli-convert.mjs.
truth: Printed cover counts and published mark-scheme answer tables. Full human transcription and crop review is not yet complete.
notes: An early Chemistry run exposed neighboring-page ownership ambiguity; Gypsum now sends exactly one core page per extraction request.
An early Biology run exposed an empty choice list for A-D labels embedded in a diagram; incomplete choices now trigger a focused extraction retry.
A crop spot-check exposed tight model boxes; Gypsum now adds bounded 2.4% page padding before cropping.
These results establish structural coverage, answer attachment, and automated audit behavior. They do not yet establish perfect verbatim transcription or perfect crops.
